format: Kotlin (Android UI test with Jetpack Compose)
description: UI test class for verifying the behavior of the Search screen in an Android app, including focus, display states, and interactions.

classes.name: SearchScreenTest
classes.description: UI test class for the Search screen, verifying focus, display states, and interactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes string resources before each test.

methods.name: searchTextField_isFocused
methods.description: Verifies that the search text field is focused when the screen loads.

methods.name: emptySearchResult_emptyScreenIsDisplayed
methods.description: Checks that the empty search result screen is shown when there are no results.

methods.name: emptySearchResult_nonEmptyRecentSearches_emptySearchScreenAndRecentSearchesAreDisplayed
methods.description: Verifies recent searches and clear button are displayed when recent searches exist.

methods.name: searchResultWithTopics_allTopicsAreVisible_followButtonsVisibleForTheNumOfFollowedTopics
methods.description: Ensures all topics are visible and follow/unfollow buttons are correctly displayed.

methods.name: searchResultWithNewsResources_firstNewsResourcesIsVisible
methods.description: Checks that the first news resource is visible in search results.

methods.name: emptyQuery_notEmptyRecentSearches_verifyClearSearchesButton_displayed
methods.description: Verifies clear searches button appears when query is empty and recent searches are present.

methods.name: searchNotReady_verifySearchNotReadyMessageIsVisible
methods.description: Checks that the 'search not ready' message is displayed when search is not ready.
